claims.claim_text: Fractile, a London and Bristol AI hardware startup, has secured backing from the UK Government's Sovereign AI Venture Fund and the British Business Bank as part of a round worth over £500 million.
claims.excerpt: has secured backing from the UK Government’s Sovereign AI Venture Fund and the British Business Bank as part of a round worth over £500 million.

claims.claim_text: The funding round values Fractile at over £5 billion.
claims.excerpt: Today’s funding round values the company at over £5 billion.

claims.claim_text: The government does not disclose the specific amount of its investment in Fractile, citing commercial sensitivity.
claims.excerpt: Like most venture capital funds we do not comment on specific investment figures as they are commercially sensitive

claims.claim_text: Fractile's Series C round also includes investors CapitalG, Lightspeed and Redpoint.
claims.excerpt: it is also being backed through this Series C round by investors including CapitalG, Lightspeed and Redpoint.

claims.claim_text: The government says Fractile's hardware is faster, more energy efficient and less costly; this is the government's characterisation, not an independent measurement.
claims.excerpt: Fractile is re-inventing the hardware that AI runs on, so that it is faster, more energy efficient, and less costly.

claims.claim_text: Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds says Fractile has plans to expand its presence in Bristol.
claims.excerpt: With plans to expand their presence in Bristol, Fractile are helping to put our plans for reindustrialisation into action

claims.claim_text: The Budget confirmed a further £140 million backing for Sovereign AI, with an additional £60 million for the Fund's investments and £80 million for its R&D Procurement Scheme.
claims.excerpt: the Chancellor confirmed a further £140 million backing for Sovereign AI, with an additional £60 million to support the Fund’s investments, plus £80 million for Sovereign AI’s R&D Procurement Scheme.

claims.claim_text: The Budget expanded the British Business Bank's investment capacity by £5 billion to £30.6 billion.
claims.excerpt: The Chancellor also expanded the British Business Bank’s investment capacity by £5 billion to £30.6 billion

claims.claim_text: Sovereign AI's typical equity investments will be worth around £1-10 million, though circumstances vary by company.
claims.excerpt: Typical equity investments will be worth around £1-10 million, though every company’s circumstances will be different.
